analysisArchitecture.aiContribution: Gemini produces one evidence-grounded diagnostic decision core; the server expands it into interventions and monitoring while deterministic calculations remain authoritative
analysisArchitecture.reconciliation: server expands the decision core into interventions, computes score targets and monitoring scaffolding, then client independently revalidates evidence and numeric guards before display
analysisArchitecture.routingRule: a semantic profile determines unit of analysis, aggregation, measures, scale direction and required analytical families; known type labels are optional routing hints, not a mandatory template
analysisArchitecture.reportPrivacyRule: official reports use neutral professional provenance wording, map internal analysis identifiers to human Arabic labels, and do not expose provider/model labels or random report tokens
analysisArchitecture.presentationBoundary: internal analyzer ids remain available for routing, while report/result presentation resolves them through a centralized public display dictionary
analysisArchitecture.visualizationRule: specialized analyzers declare or imply analytical intent; a shared semantic visualization policy selects a safe chart form without changing source calculations

runtime.legacyEnhanceFastOperation: retained server-side for backward compatibility; the current frontend uses analyze_primary
primaryModelFallbackOrder: decision core: configured GEMINI_ANALYSIS_MODEL first; one distinct fast fallback candidate second
runtime.transientRetryBackoff: no model storm: 429 stops immediately; capacity/timeout/network may switch once to one distinct fallback model
runtime.corsAllowedOriginNormalization: URL origin, including GitHub Pages URLs with repository paths
runtime.modelOverridePolicy: generation-agnostic normalized model names; optional fallback lists are configurable without a hard-coded Gemini generation family guard
runtime.primaryAutomaticReplayPolicy: one browser request per click; Edge may try one primary model plus one fallback only
runtime.decisionCoreScorePayload: metrics-and-charts-only; no raw score sampleRows or row evidence refs

acceptanceCoverage.primaryAiOwnership: Gemini generates one evidence-grounded diagnostic decision core; the server expands it into interventions and monitoring using deterministic evidence and guards
acceptanceCoverage.localOwnership: data extraction, validation, calculations, metrics, charts, evidence references, intervention arithmetic and monitoring scaffolding
acceptanceCoverage.evidenceGate: unknown evidence references are removed server-side and client-side
acceptanceCoverage.minimumResult: 2-3 evidence-backed decision units from one Gemini decision core; server expands them to at least 2 interventions and exactly 3 monitoring stages
acceptanceCoverage.variableCounts: decision core uses 2-3 bounded analytical units; no segmented repair/rescue chain exists in the primary path
acceptanceCoverage.failureBehavior: no official report is shown when the primary AI analysis fails
acceptanceCoverage.cacheBehavior: successful decision-core analysis is cached locally by evidence fingerprint for 24 hours; force rerun bypasses cache
acceptanceCoverage.nonDuplication: diagnosticAnalysis and decisionFinding are separate fields and near-duplicate text is rejected
acceptanceCoverage.scopeGuard: aggregate score data cannot name a specific skill or concept without item-level evidence
acceptanceCoverage.numericInterventionGuard: score interventions use structured group IDs and server-owned arithmetic; impossible targets are reduced to feasible limits and revalidated in the browser
acceptanceCoverage.docxMetadata: school, subject, grade, academic year, report date, region and school code are extracted from Word headers/footers when present
acceptanceCoverage.aggregateNarrativeContext: opposing statements in aggregated reports are treated as contextual variation unless the same teacher, visit and time are evidenced
acceptanceCoverage.multiVisitSupervisionPdf: extract visits, 13 reversed-scale indicators, narratives and metadata; compare only within explicit visit context
acceptanceCoverage.transientGeminiFallback: one primary Gemini model plus at most one distinct fallback; 429 stops immediately and there is no action/repair/rescue fan-out
acceptanceCoverage.multiVisitScopeGuard: interventions are limited to the teachers, department, subjects and visits present in the analyzed sample; broader school-wide targets are narrowed server-side and revalidated in the browser
acceptanceCoverage.semanticRouter: every supported input receives a local structural profile and Gemini semantic verification; setup controls and analyzer selection follow the profile rather than a single universal method
acceptanceCoverage.aggregateDistribution: grouped level distributions use level columns and exclude aggregate rows from totals, then use aggregate values only for consistency checks
acceptanceCoverage.multiSubjectWorkspace: supports all-subject or one-subject analysis, local top-ten tables, weighted school ranking, standard competition ties, and exclusion of records missing a core subject
acceptanceCoverage.visualizationEngine: shared intent-first policy selects charts across all analyzers; report and workspace render the same semantic chart contract without modifying deterministic calculations
acceptanceCoverage.multiSubjectPdfIntake: specialized adapter recovers the complete student-by-subject matrix and full student identity from repeated RTL PDF pages, requires contiguous student serials, excludes legend-only pages, and preserves nonnumeric special records outside arithmetic

performance.resultsPresentation: results appear only after the primary AI analysis passes evidence validation
performance.networkRequestsPerAnalysis: 1 browser Edge request per click; inside Edge: 1 Gemini request normally, at most 2 with one fallback
performance.latencyStrategy: 38-second Edge decision-core deadline: primary model up to 23 seconds, one fallback up to 13 seconds; browser envelope 50 seconds; no full-request replay
performance.scoreAiPayload: score-like analysis sends deterministic metrics/charts only; raw score sample rows and row evidence refs are omitted
performance.decisionCoreCache: 24-hour local evidence-fingerprint cache, maximum 6 successful analyses

backwardCompatibility.legacyEnhanceFastOperation: retained server-side for backward compatibility; the current frontend uses analyze_primary
